//TR: Bu checkpoint Founder'ın 2026-10-01 çift bağımsız inceleme talimatının son sürüm bölümünü kaydeder: release adayı paketlenmeden, imzalanmadan ve kurulmadan önce CLAUDE_FULL_REPO_REVIEW ve CODEX_FULL_REPO_REVIEW aynı değişmez adayda CLEAN olmalıdır. releaseAuditContract alanları her denetim bundle'ının gereksinimlerine alıntılanır.
founderDirective: Founder directive 2026-10-01 (ADD CLAUDE AS A SECOND INDEPENDENT REVIEW PROVIDER), final release section: before final release closure both CLAUDE_FULL_REPO_REVIEW and CODEX_FULL_REPO_REVIEW must run on the same immutable release candidate and both must be CLEAN; the supervisor orchestrates it; quota never fabricates CLEAN; no reviewer overrules another's valid finding.

founderAuthorization.rule: Explicit Founder directive of 2026-10-01; the protected files strictly necessary for the release-audit gate are authorized; every change keeps or strengthens trust: packaging, signing and Phase0 additionally require two independent CLEAN full-repository audits of the candidate.
protectedFiles: scripts/dual-review-selftest.mjs (held-package scenario runs as a DR1 plane)
founderAuthorization.constraint: release-audit gate only; package review rules, reviewer contracts and the Codex reviewer are unchanged; no new external network, credential or signing access

releaseAuditContract.base: deterministic unsigned empty-tree commit 53c1d24822689b2b1e1ca0d98a1ff117d937864d (tree 4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904, fixed identity UASCO Release Audit, dates 1970-01-01T00:00:00+0000)
releaseAuditContract.order: AUDIT_FREEZE -> AUDIT claude -> AUDIT codex -> PACKAGE -> SIGN -> PHASE0
releaseAuditContract.onBlocked: AUDIT_BLOCKED: the release lane stops; a remediation package produces a new candidate, which starts a fresh audit

design.engine: orchestrator-engine.mjs: newRelease creates AUDIT_PENDING with an audit object when policy.releaseAudit.required; nextAction schedules AUDIT_FREEZE, then AUDIT per reviewer by provider state; updateReviewerGate (shared with package review, extracted from applyDualReview without behavior change) + applyReleaseAudit: both CLEAN -> PACKAGE_PENDING with evidence, any valid BLOCKED -> AUDIT_BLOCKED with aggregated attributed findings, INVALID -> Founder decision; PACKAGE outcome AUDIT_REQUIRED converts an unaudited release into a pending audit
design.executors: orchestrator-executors.mjs: auditFreeze (clean clone of the candidate, verified empty base, canonical validation, buildFrozenBundle with the policy contract, scope prefixes from the candidate tree, refuses a non-full-tree bundle), AUDIT reuses reviewDual through auditTarget (own clean clone per reviewer, empty base recreated and verified in each clone), releaseAuditGate (PACKAGE, SIGN and PHASE0) re-derives both audit evidences with their identities against the audit bundle and sends an unaudited release to the audit first; the packaging record carries the audit result; ledger directory created before writing
design.activation: orchestrator-daemon.mjs: the first tick of a DR2+ plane records RELEASE_AUDIT_ACTIVATED once (control.releaseAuditActivation with the control-plane commit) and releases packages held until RELEASE_AUDIT_ACTIVE through the DR1 releaseActivationHolds helper; older planes never act on such a package because of its far-future notBefore
design.contracts: command-contracts.mjs: git.auditEmptyBase (commit-tree of the empty tree, --no-gpg-sign, identity and dates fixed in config arguments and in the environment so inherited GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_* variables cannot change it, controlRoot clones only, no ref change)
design.state: orchestrator-state.mjs: RELEASE_STATUSES gain AUDIT_PENDING and AUDIT_BLOCKED
design.watchdog: watchdog-status.mjs: releaseAudit list; AUDIT_BLOCKED releases are blocked lanes and RELEASE_AUDIT_BLOCKED health reasons
design.prompt: prompts/RELEASE-AUDIT-REVIEW.txt (ASCII, frozen per bundle); the Claude reviewer system prompt notes that diff.patch is normally omitted for a full-tree audit

advisoryReview.reviewer: CLAUDE_REVIEWER (DR1 control plane, advisory, not gate evidence)
advisoryReview.reported: CLEAN with advisories; governed REJECTED for schema (extra property steps_note in advisory reproduction)
remediated: F-DR2-ADV-001 P2: SIGN and PHASE0 now also apply the release-audit gate
F-DR2-ADV-002 P2: audit base identity pinned in the environment as well as config
F-DR2-ADV-003 P3: AUDIT_BLOCKED release adds a watchdog health reason
